title: CDPSE® Certification (Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer)
body: Information Systems Audit and Control Association (ISACA)
summary: The technical data privacy engineering credential bridging legal compliance with software architecture, Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs), and data lifecycle management across Privacy Governance (34%), Privacy Architecture (36%), and Data Lifecycle (30%).

standard.name: Standard Privacy Engineering Track
standard.blurb: Pass the 120-question examination (scaled score 450/800) and verify 3 years of technical privacy experience (2-year waiver available for CISA/CISSP/CISM).

nodes.name: Domain 1: Privacy Governance
nodes.description: Privacy programs, privacy policies, cross-border data transfer mechanisms, Privacy Impact Assessments (PIA/DPIA), and privacy audits.
topics: Global Privacy Laws: GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, LGPD & Cross-Border Data Transfers
Privacy Governance Frameworks: NIST Privacy Framework, ISO/IEC 27701
Data Protection by Design & by Default Principles
Privacy Impact Assessments (PIA) & Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA)
Privacy Incident Handling, Data Breach Notification & Regulatory Reporting

stages.title: Stage 2: Technical Privacy Architecture & Data Lifecycle
stages.subtitle: Domain 2: Privacy Architecture (36%) & Domain 3: Data Lifecycle (30%)

nodes.name: Domain 2: Privacy Architecture
nodes.description: Technical privacy infrastructure, API security, identity federation, Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs), encryption, tokenization, anonymization, and differential privacy.
topics: Privacy Architecture in Cloud & Distributed Microservices
Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs): Differential Privacy, Homomorphic Encryption
Cryptographic Protection of PII & Key Management Life Cycle

nodes.name: Domain 3: Data Lifecycle
nodes.description: Data inventory and mapping (RoPA), purpose specification, data minimization, data quality, data retention, subject access requests (DSARs), and secure data destruction.
topics: Data Flow Mapping & Records of Processing Activities (RoPA)
Data Subject Rights Automation: Right of Access, Rectification, Erasure (Right to be Forgotten)
Data Retention Schedules & Verifiable Cryptographic Data Sanitization

stages.title: Stage 3: Examination Sitting & Experience Verification
stages.subtitle: 120-Question Exam + 3 Years Experience (2-Year Waiver with CISA/CISSP)

nodes.name: CDPSE Computer-Based Examination
nodes.description: Computer-based examination testing privacy governance, privacy architecture, and data lifecycle management. Scaled passing score: 450 out of 800.

nodes.name: 3 Years Privacy Experience (2-Yr Waiver Available)
nodes.description: Document 3 years of work experience in technical privacy governance, architecture, or data operations. Holders of active CISA, CISM, or CISSP receive an automatic 2-year experience waiver.
topics: 2-Year Experience Waiver for CISA, CISM, or CISSP Holders

nodes.name: CDPSE Credential Conferred & Annual CPE
nodes.description: Conferral of the Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE) designation. Requires 20 CPE hours annually (120 over 3 years) and adherence to ISACA ethics.
